name: network-firewall
description: This is the API Reference for Network Firewall.

subcommands.name: accept-network-firewall-transit-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Accepts a transit gateway attachment request for Network Firewall.

subcommands.name: associate-availability-zones
subcommands.description: Associates the specified Availability Zones with a transit gateway-attached firewall.

subcommands.name: associate-firewall-policy
subcommands.description: Associates a FirewallPolicy to a Firewall.

subcommands.name: associate-subnets
subcommands.description: Associates the specified subnets in the Amazon VPC to the firewall.

subcommands.name: attach-rule-groups-to-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Attaches ProxyRuleGroup resources to a ProxyConfiguration A Proxy Configuration defines the monitoring and protection behavior for a Proxy.

subcommands.name: create-container-association
subcommands.description: Creates a Network Firewall container association.

subcommands.name: create-firewall
subcommands.description: Creates an Network Firewall Firewall and accompanying FirewallStatus for a VPC.

subcommands.name: create-firewall-policy
subcommands.description: Creates the firewall policy for the firewall according to the specifications.

subcommands.name: create-proxy
subcommands.description: Creates an Network Firewall Proxy Attaches a Proxy configuration to a NAT Gateway.

subcommands.name: create-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an Network Firewall ProxyConfiguration A Proxy Configuration defines the monitoring and protection behavior for a Proxy.

subcommands.name: create-proxy-rule-group
subcommands.description: Creates an Network Firewall ProxyRuleGroup Collections of related proxy filtering rules.

subcommands.name: create-proxy-rules
subcommands.description: Creates Network Firewall ProxyRule resources.

subcommands.name: create-rule-group
subcommands.description: Creates the specified stateless or stateful rule group, which includes the rules for network traffic inspection, a capacity setting, and tags.

subcommands.name: create-tls-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an Network Firewall TLS inspection configuration.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-endpoint-association
subcommands.description: Creates a firewall endpoint for an Network Firewall firewall.

subcommands.name: delete-container-association
subcommands.description: Deletes a container association.

subcommands.name: delete-firewall
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Firewall and its FirewallStatus.

subcommands.name: delete-firewall-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified FirewallPolicy.

subcommands.name: delete-network-firewall-transit-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Deletes a transit gateway attachment from a Network Firewall.

subcommands.name: delete-proxy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Proxy.

subcommands.name: delete-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified ProxyConfiguration.

subcommands.name: delete-proxy-rule-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified ProxyRuleGroup.

subcommands.name: delete-proxy-rules
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified ProxyRule(s).

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource policy that you created in a PutResourcePolicy request.

subcommands.name: delete-rule-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified RuleGroup.

subcommands.name: delete-tls-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified TLSInspectionConfiguration.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-endpoint-association
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified VpcEndpointAssociation.

subcommands.name: describe-container-association
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration and status of a container association.

subcommands.name: describe-firewall
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified firewall.

subcommands.name: describe-firewall-metadata
subcommands.description: Returns the high-level information about a firewall, including the Availability Zones where the Firewall is currently in use.

subcommands.name: describe-firewall-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified firewall policy.

subcommands.name: describe-flow-operation
subcommands.description: Returns key information about a specific flow operation.

subcommands.name: describe-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the logging configuration for the specified firewall.

subcommands.name: describe-proxy
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified proxy.

subcommands.name: describe-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified proxy configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-proxy-rule
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified proxy configuration for the specified proxy rule group.

subcommands.name: describe-proxy-rule-group
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified proxy rule group.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves a resource policy that you created in a PutResourcePolicy request.

subcommands.name: describe-rule-group
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified rule group.

subcommands.name: describe-rule-group-metadata
subcommands.description: High-level information about a rule group, returned by operations like create and describe.

subcommands.name: describe-rule-group-summary
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information for a stateful rule group.

subcommands.name: describe-tls-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the data objects for the specified TLS inspection configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-endpoint-association
subcommands.description: Returns the data object for the specified VPC endpoint association.

subcommands.name: detach-rule-groups-from-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Detaches ProxyRuleGroup resources from a ProxyConfiguration A Proxy Configuration defines the monitoring and protection behavior for a Proxy.

subcommands.name: disassociate-availability-zones
subcommands.description: Removes the specified Availability Zone associations from a transit gateway-attached firewall.

subcommands.name: disassociate-subnets
subcommands.description: Removes the specified subnet associations from the firewall.

subcommands.name: get-analysis-report-results
subcommands.description: The results of a COMPLETED analysis report generated with StartAnalysisReport.

subcommands.name: list-analysis-reports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all traffic analysis reports generated within the last 30 days.

subcommands.name: list-container-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the container associations in your account and Region.

subcommands.name: list-firewall-policies
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the firewall policies that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-firewalls
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the firewalls that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-flow-operation-results
subcommands.description: Returns the results of a specific flow operation.

subcommands.name: list-flow-operations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all flow operations ran in a specific firewall.

subcommands.name: list-proxies
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the proxies that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-proxy-configurations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the proxy configuration that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-proxy-rule-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the proxy rule groups that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-rule-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the rule groups that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the tags associated with the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-tls-inspection-configurations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the TLS inspection configurations that you have defined.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoint-associations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata for the VPC endpoint associations that you have defined.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an IAM policy for your rule group, firewall policy, or firewall.

subcommands.name: reject-network-firewall-transit-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Rejects a transit gateway attachment request for Network Firewall.

subcommands.name: start-analysis-report
subcommands.description: Generates a traffic analysis report for the timeframe and traffic type you specify.

subcommands.name: start-flow-capture
subcommands.description: Begins capturing the flows in a firewall, according to the filters you define.

subcommands.name: start-flow-flush
subcommands.description: Begins the flushing of traffic from the firewall, according to the filters you define.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the tags with the specified keys from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-availability-zone-change-protection
subcommands.description: Modifies the AvailabilityZoneChangeProtection setting for a transit gateway-attached firewall.

subcommands.name: update-container-association
subcommands.description: Updates the monitoring configurations and description of a container association.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-analysis-settings
subcommands.description: Enables specific types of firewall analysis on a specific firewall you define.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-delete-protection
subcommands.description: Modifies the flag, DeleteProtection, which indicates whether it is possible to delete the firewall.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-description
subcommands.description: Modifies the description for the specified firewall.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-encryption-configuration
subcommands.description: A complex type that contains settings for encryption of your firewall resources.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of the specified firewall policy.

subcommands.name: update-firewall-policy-change-protection
subcommands.description: Modifies the flag, ChangeProtection, which indicates whether it is possible to change the firewall.

subcommands.name: update-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Sets the logging configuration for the specified firewall.

subcommands.name: update-proxy
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of the specified proxy.

subcommands.name: update-proxy-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of the specified proxy configuration.

subcommands.name: update-proxy-rule
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of the specified proxy rule.

subcommands.description: Updates proxy rule group priorities within a proxy configuration.

subcommands.name: update-proxy-rule-priorities
subcommands.description: Updates proxy rule priorities within a proxy rule group.

subcommands.name: update-rule-group
subcommands.description: Updates the rule settings for the specified rule group.

subcommands.description: Updates the TLS inspection configuration settings for the specified TLS inspection configuration.
